title: PEG mediated destabilization of holo alpha-lactalbumin probed by in silico and in vitro studies: deviation from excluded volume effect.
authors: Raina, Neha; Hassan, Md Imtaiyaz; Ahmad, Faizan; Islam, Asimul; Singh, Amit Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PEG对α-乳清蛋白的稳定性影响，虽涉及分子动力学模拟和对接，但对象为蛋白-聚合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Crowded and confined macromolecular milieus surround proteins, and both are stabilizing if the nature of the interaction between crowder and proteins are considered hard-core repulsive interactions. However, non-specific chemical interactions between a protein and its surroundings also play a significant role and the sum effect of both hard-core repulsion and soft interaction balances the overall effect of crowding/confinement. Previous studies showing the effect of polyethylene glycol (PEG) on protein and nucleic acid may be interpreted as either primarily excluded volume effect or, in some cases, chemical effect by changing solvent properties. In case of destabilizing interactions, charge-charge and hydrophobic contact have to gain more attention. For instance, in vitro and in vivo studies using protein as crowding agent revealed the destabilization of proteins induced by charge-charge interactions. To investigate the effect of PEG 10 kDa on holo alpha-lactalbumin (holo alpha-LA), structure and thermal stability of the protein were measured at different pH values using several techniques. Structural characterization by Trp-fluorescence, near-UV CD and far-UV measurements at different pH values clearly shows perturbation of tertiary and secondary structure of holo alpha-LA by PEG 10 kDa. Furthermore, the dynamic light scattering measurement shows that the protein is homogeneous under all experimental conditions. Analysis of the heat-induced denaturation profile in the presence of the crowder shows destabilization of the protein in terms of T(m) (midpoint of denaturation) and DeltaG(D)(0) (Gibbs free energy change at 25  degrees C). To evaluate the interaction of PEG 10 kDa with holo alpha-LA and stability of PEG-alpha-LA complex, docking and molecular dynamic simulation were carried out for 100 ns.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 拥挤且受限的大分子环境包围着蛋白质，若考虑拥挤剂与蛋白质之间的相互作用为硬核排斥相互作用，则两者均具有稳定作用。然而，蛋白质与其周围环境之间的非特异性化学相互作用也起着重要作用，硬核排斥与软相互作用的综合效应平衡了拥挤/受限的整体影响。以往关于聚乙二醇（PEG）对蛋白质和核酸影响的研究，可能被解释为主要为排除体积效应，或在某些情况下，通过改变溶剂性质产生的化学效应。在去稳定化相互作用的情况下，电荷-电荷和疏水接触需受到更多关注。例如，使用蛋白质作为拥挤剂的体外和体内研究揭示了由电荷-电荷相互作用诱导的蛋白质去稳定化。为研究PEG 10 kDa对全α-乳白蛋白（holo alpha-LA）的影响，在不同pH值下使用多种技术测量了该蛋白质的结构和热稳定性。通过Trp-荧光、近紫外圆二色（near-UV CD）和远紫外测量在不同pH值下的结构表征清晰显示，PEG 10 kDa扰动了holo alpha-LA的三级和二级结构。此外，动态光散射测量表明，在所有实验条件下蛋白质均保持均一。在拥挤剂存在下，热诱导变性曲线的分析显示，蛋白质在T(m)（变性中点）和DeltaG(D)(0)（25摄氏度下的吉布斯自由能变化）方面发生去稳定化。为评估PEG 10 kDa与holo alpha-LA的相互作用及PEG-alpha-LA复合物的稳定性，进行了100 ns的对接和分子动力学模拟。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
